text:
ana (partnerships): quick sync — we need to lock the joint marketplace launch plan for next month. core ask: press embargo, landing page, partner marketplace listing, SI integration notes. who can take which piece? :spiral_calendar:

mike (marketing): i can own press + blog assets. need final one-liner from partners and the co-brand logo pack by EOD thurs. :white_check_mark:

sara (product): i'll own the landing page copy and the feature callouts. lucas, can we get the technical integration steps for the SI doc?

lucas (eng): yes, i'll draft the SI integration README and a quickstart in a repo. ETA fri morning. do we want code samples for k8s + helm + marketplace deploy?

mike (marketing): yes to k8s + helm + marketplace install snippets. also want a short gif demo for the blog hero — can someone record 30s?

ana (partnerships): @ana re: assets — partner legal needs an asset usage agreement. rachel can you confirm if the existing co-marketing template covers marketplace screenshots?

rachel (legal): i can review. send me the screenshot pack and the proposed usage terms. i'll flag anything risky by thursday.

ana (oops typo) — actually meant to ping @rachel.

ana: also we need region-specific marketplace descriptions (NA / EU / APAC) for localized catalog listings. who can handle translations? we have partner-funded i18n budget if needed.

mike (marketing): i can coordinate translations (basic). we'll prioritize EN + FR + DE for launch, add JP/KR next sprint.

sara (product): landing page will have an activation CTA that triggers marketplace redirect. lucas, ensure redirect patterns include region detection header fallback.

lucas (eng): noted. will implement geo header check + fallback to region selector. also adding metrics hooks for tracking referral source (partner tag).

ana: embargo windows — partner has asked for embargo until next-wed 16:00 PT. press_bot, can you schedule embargo notice and set a reminder 1 day before?

press_bot: embargo noted. scheduling reminder: 1769900000 (one day prior). will post reminder in #marketing and ping partners three hours before release.

mike (marketing): timeline check — draft press + blog out mon, legal signoff tues, asset pack to partners weds am, embargo lift weds 16:00 PT, live on marketplace thurs 09:00 PT. sound right?

sara (product): works for product, as long as lucas's SI doc and quickstart are staged by weds EOD for QA.

lucas (eng): can do weds EOD. will drop a short checklist in the repo:

```
- repo: /partners/si-quickstart
- README with architecture diagram
- helm chart + values example
- marketplace install guide
- smoke test script: ./smoke.sh
```

ana: owners recap: mike = press/blog/assets, sara = landing page + CTA, lucas = SI docs + redirects/metrics, rachel = legal review, ana = partner coordination + dry-run. i'll send an updated checklist and a shared spreadsheet for asset handoff.

mike (marketing): i'll mock hero gif and a 2-sentence partner quote placeholder — need partner to confirm quote by tues.

rachel (legal): once i get assets i'll reply inline. quick note: do not include partner's internal pricing numbers in public copy.

sara (product): can someone add the partner's logo SVGs to the shared drive and give me links?

ana (partnerships): uploaded logo pack to drive: https://drive.redwood/partner-assets/si-cohort/logos (please use the approved variants only).

lucas (eng): added initial README draft: https://git.redwood/partners/si-quickstart/pull/1 — feedback welcome, i'll iterate.

mike (marketing): small ask — can we get a 1-sentence blurb for cloud marketplace benefits (cost + latency + SLA) for the top of the catalog card? partner marketing, please add.

partner_representative (external): thanks everyone — we'll confirm quote + blurb by tues noon. excited to launch together.

ana: great — next sync friday 09:30 PT for dry-run. if anything blocks earlier, drop updates here. :rocket:
